title: fix(plugin-email): an option hole prints the option label in each recipient's language

domain:server#5 card thread · session `session_016WV4czh582ycXhGxZNVPVi` · branch `claude/project-thread-9ookwa` (the card thread's platform-assigned branch, named in the re-posted claim on #30730). Built on PR #30727's head `98f61ec6` (branch `claude/project-thread-d8v0qv`, the spec half), then `origin/main` `b3098661` merged in. Until #30727 lands, this PR's diff against `main` also carries #30727's commits; the plugin-email half is the last three commits.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：邮件模板里的 `{{ stage | option:opportunity.stage }}` 现在真正按收件人的语言印出选项标签：同一封商机滞留通知，英文同事读到 Needs Analysis，中文同事读到「需求分析」；定时流程以系统身份发出也一样逐人翻译。
- 为什么改：规格半（PR #30727）让这种写法通过保存校验，但邮件服务从不准备标签表，所以每次发送都以裸 `RangeError` 失败、一封也发不出；HotCRM 至今只能手写各语言标签表。
- 风险与回滚：只影响写了 `option` 的模板；对象不存在、字段不存在、字段没有选项（含空选项列表）都整封拒发并报 `TEMPLATE_INVALID`，不会发出错误内容。回滚即还原本 PR（之后这类模板回到发不出去的状态）。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/option-label-table.ts`（建表与拒绝）；`src/email-service.ts` 中 `resolveAndRenderTemplate` 新增的建表段（语言取发送的 `locale`）；`src/template-engine.ts` 的 `option` 判定。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/template-option-formatter.render.test.ts src/template-option-labels.integration.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件 20 例全绿，其中 zh-CN 收件人读到「需求分析」「赢单」，en-US 读到 Needs Analysis。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（与 #30727 背靠背，规格半先落）。

## What changes

- **The label table (`option-label-table.ts`, new).** `buildOptionLabelTable(faces, locale, sources)` collects the `object.field` keys the template's `option` holes name (`parseMailHole(...).optionField`), reads each named object's SERVED definition (`IDataEngine.getObject`, where a picklist-bound field carries its resolved list and its `picklist` name), and builds, per key, stored value to label, with the i18n service's bundle laid over the option-declaring fields by `translateObject` with the same `fallbackChain` / `defaultLocale` options. That is the step sequence of `@objectstack/objectql`'s `readerOptionLabels` (`formula-option-labels.ts`), the path a formula's `label()` reads; see Acceptance notes for why it is taken through the same two published functions rather than imported. A test holds the two answers equal.
- **Which locale.** The send's own `locale` (the recipient's; the messaging channels resolve it per recipient and pass it to `sendTemplate` / `renderTemplate`), trimmed as the template ladder reads it. Never the resolved row's locale and never an execution context's, so a scheduled flow running as the system still mails each recipient in their language. No locale reads the declared labels (ruling F, parameter 3).
- **Refusals.** Before any face renders, every face is judged with `judgeMailHoleGrammar(face, { objects, liveUniverse: true })` against the served objects the holes name: an object nothing serves (`option-object-unknown`), a field the object does not have (`option-field-unknown`), a field with no options (`option-field-no-options`). Each throws `TEMPLATE_INVALID`, prefixed with the template and locale as every renderer refusal is, and the whole send is refused: nothing reaches the transport. **Decided here (the carry note leaves it to this card):** a field whose served option list is empty (`options: []`, which the formula side answers with a `{}` table and no refusal) is judged as a field with no options and refused the same way; the renderer also refuses a `{}` table handed to it directly.
- **The renderer (`template-engine.ts`).** `RenderOptions.optionLabels` (new) is passed to `formatValue`. For an `option` hole the renderer asks `optionTableRefusal` before `formatValue` and prefixes `TEMPLATE_INVALID`, the way it asks `currencyDefaultRefusal`; so a send with no table (a host with no data engine) is refused `TEMPLATE_INVALID` with the formula's sentence, never a bare `RangeError`.
- **The wiring (`email-service.ts`, `email-plugin.ts`).** `EmailService.setOptionLabelSources(read)` (new, not exported from the package index); the plugin wires it in `init` to read the data engine (`objectql`, else `data`) and the `i18n` service at each send (resolve where used: a service registered later is seen, nothing is recorded). The table is built once per send for the three faces, and only when a face has an `option` hole.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-email` patch.

## Tests

- `src/template-option-formatter.render.test.ts` (new), through `EmailService.renderTemplate` / `sendTemplate` with a recording transport:
  - an `en-US` and a `zh-CN` recipient each read their own label on all three faces (subject, HTML double and triple brace, text);
  - a scheduled flow running as the system: one `data` object built once, sent to `en-US`, `zh-CN`, `en-US` recipients with no `sentBy` and no organization, each reading their own label, the payload unchanged;
  - no locale reads the declared labels even when the resolved row is `zh-CN`; a value outside the options prints as stored and a multi-select labels each value; a picklist-bound field reads the shared list's translation; the sources are asked once, only for the named object;
  - refusals: an unknown object, an unknown field, a field with no options, an empty option list, each `TEMPLATE_INVALID` naming the template and hole, with nothing sent; no sources wired is `TEMPLATE_INVALID` with `optionTableRefusal`'s sentence; the renderer refuses an empty table; a template with no `option` hole never asks for the sources;
  - parity: for `zh-CN`, `zh`, `en-US` and no locale, the mail table's stage labels equal what a real `ObjectQL` engine's formula `label(record.stage)` reads for the same object and i18n service.
- `src/template-option-labels.integration.test.ts` (new): the real `EmailServicePlugin` booted on an `ObjectKernel` with `ObjectQLPlugin`, an app declaring the object and templates, and an `i18n` service: `en-US` and `zh-CN` recipients read `Needs Analysis` and `需求分析`; a template naming an object the deployment does not serve is refused `TEMPLATE_INVALID` and nothing is sent.

## Acceptance notes

- **Why not import `readerOptionLabels`.** `@objectstack/objectql` is only a dev dependency of `@objectstack/plugin-email`, so no export of `formula-option-labels.ts` reaches it at runtime, and promoting it to a runtime dependency is a `package.json` / lockfile change outside this card's surface. So `formula-option-labels.ts` is untouched (no export added), and the table takes the same steps through the same published functions (`translateObject` from `@objectstack/spec/system`, `declaresOptions` from `@objectstack/formula`), as `service-analytics`' `translateSelectOptions` already does. The parity describe holds the answers equal; a later move of the shared steps into one module both packages depend on would delete the copy.
- **The system-run pin is at the plugin-email layer.** It drives `sendTemplate` the way the `email` channel does after fan-out (one payload, the recipient's `locale`, no user, no organization). The fan-out itself (`service-automation` notify, `service-messaging` channels) is outside this card's file surface and is not driven here; the channels already pass the recipient's locale (decision analysis 6658266694, reading 1).
- **`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, re-derived from this diff.** What an author can write is unchanged here: the `option` formatter, its grammar and its authoring checks are #30727's (which declares `yes (widening)` / `added`). This diff makes the runtime deliver what that grammar promises; no public export of the package changes (`EmailService` is not exported from the index) and `IEmailService` is unchanged.
- Skills follow-up for the formatter is #30731 (the spec half's); nothing in `skills/**` changes here.
